title: Claude Desktop app data
whyItMatters: Claude Desktop keeps a local configuration, logs and cached app state here. It shows the desktop app was used on this computer and which local tools it was allowed to start.
source: Model Context Protocol docs for Claude Desktop: Linux config and logs under ~/.config/Claude - https://modelcontextprotocol.io/docs/2026-07-28/develop/connect-local-servers
notes: Config and logs used by the Linux beta of Claude Desktop, including claude_desktop_config.json. Conversations are account-based; nothing is opened. Supported on Ubuntu 22.04+ and Debian 12+.

cleanup.signOut: Sign out of Claude Desktop on this computer so the account no longer keeps a signed-in session here.
steps: Uninstall Claude from your software manager or the package you used.
Delete the Claude folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes the local Claude configuration and logs from this computer. Conversations stored with the account stay there.
cleanup.source: Claude Help Center, Install Claude Desktop: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/10065433-install-claude-desktop
